options.epe.targetFps.tooltip: The framerate EPE tries to maintain. When FPS drops below this, EPE dynamically scales down non-essential visuals and restores them once performance stabilizes.
options.epe.autoQuality.tooltip: Automatically adapts entity distance, particles, clouds, and simulation load to maintain smooth, consistent frame times.
options.epe.engineOptimizer.tooltip: Optimizes Minecraft's chunk draw-list generation: shares view matrices, pre-sizes buffers, and caches uniform uploaders to eliminate thousands of CPU allocations per second.
options.epe.earlyZ.tooltip: Sorts opaque chunk sections front-to-back, allowing the GPU's hardware depth tester to automatically discard hidden geometry before running pixel shaders.
options.epe.blockEntityCulling.tooltip: Adaptively culls distant tile entities (chests, signs, banners) in large storage rooms and bases, significantly improving framerate.
options.epe.budgetedUploads.tooltip: Smoothly budgets chunk mesh GPU uploads across frames with dynamic elasticity to eliminate micro-stutters during terrain generation.
